purpose: Narrow successor to the rejected v3 delivery join: preserve its independently passing host-finalizer semantics and repair only admitted tuple identity so the commitment encodes exactly the six declared dimensions and no admission metadata.

predecessorRejection.repairScope: only admitted tuple encoding and commitment; invalid complement commitment and all finalizer transformations remain exact v3 semantics

protocolReference.applicationRule: The exact five v4 files require different-author independent acceptance and formal application together.

retainedV3RepairBoundary.rule: After deleting the added retainedV3RepairBoundary and comparing permitted paths by their declared v4 replacements, every other recursive value, object member order and array order is exact v3 semantic inheritance.

retainedV2SemanticProjection.rule: Every inherited selector is exact recursive type/value/order equality with v2. HostFinalizerContextV2 and every DEFER/PRESERVE label are non-authoritative and absent from v4.

hostFinalizerBoundaryV4.ownership: Host-only checked transformation. Provider supplies only its already-normalized observation; it never supplies requiredness, C-1 sufficiency, base/final axes, settlement, HostTermination, class, codes or exit.

deficiency.why: Which Coverage/verdict deficiency applies. Without it, coverage-missing and provider-unavailable share axes yet carry different remedies.

rejectionCause.why: Which request rejection applies. identity-expired requires tombstone evidence; identity-unknown is its absence — the distinction A2-D9-V12-05 required and the v1.4 enum rewrite regressed.

faultCause.why: Which operational fault applies. Distinguishes contention (retry) from corruption (repair).

secondaryDeficiencies.why: A Run can genuinely carry more than one deficiency (no TS provider AND an exhausted Rust budget). v1.5 had one deficiency slot, so the extra reason codes on the wire were unconstrained: B-D9V15-03 showed a second reasonCode could be appended and the checker exited 0. The ordered code list is now derived in full from (deficiency, secondaryDeficiencies), so an undeclared code is rejected.
constraints: must not contain the primary deficiency

projectionScope.note: When host-finalization-only, lifecycle/durability describe the failing host operation only; they do not assert the Run never existed (R2-D9-02).

exactPinnedScenarioAxesSchema.nullPolicy: No axis is ever explicitly null. not-applicable is a value; absence is invalid.
exactPinnedScenarioAxesSchema.whyEnums: v1.3 used booleans. A boolean cannot express unknown or not-applicable, which forced inputs asserting states the architecture forbids (verdict=pass with required coverage unsatisfied). The type was wrong and the wrong type produced the wrong values.

baseAxesContract.requiredNarrowing: Every HostFinalizerContextV4 baseAxes contains all fourteen ordered fields, including projectionScope even though D9 declares it optional.
baseAxesContract.profileRule: baseAxesProfile selects one exact profile; baseAxes must equal its full record byte-semantically. No partial/presence-only axes or unlisted combination is admitted.

hostIdentityV4.narrowing: This finite candidate admits exactly this host-owned identity fixture; it is never provider supplied. A future widening needs its own closed format validation.

c1PredicateRelativeSufficiencyV4.algorithm: For the same relation only, available rung rank must be >= minimum rung rank and complete must satisfy complete. Evaluate every listed predicate; derivedSufficiency=sufficient iff all pass. No global provider-quality boolean or cross-relation ordering.

effectiveProviderRequired.algorithm: true exactly when admittedProviderRequiredness=required OR any predicate-relative input derives insufficient

fields.baseAxes: exact full selected profile axes in orderedFields order

authority tuple binds baseAxesProfile and termination digest
settlementOptionV4.returnRule: For signal-after-finalization return hostTerminationCanonicalBytesHex byte-for-byte. Reconstructing from axes, class, booleans or partial result is forbidden.

finiteContextDomain.tupleEncoding: UTF-8 compact JSON array of closed tupleRecordV4Schema objects in dimension cartesian order; every object contains exactly the six dimensionOrder fields in that order. Row ids, admissionRuleId and all other admission metadata are excluded from tuple identity and from commitment bytes.
finiteContextDomain.admissionRuleMetadata: admittedRows.id identifies the unique rule that admits a tuple for audit explanation only; it is neither a seventh dimension nor a tuple field and is never encoded into admittedTupleCommitment or invalidCombinations.tupleCommitment

invalidCombinations.definition: exact cartesian complement of admittedRows; no transformation is evaluated

finiteContextDomain.partitionRule: Enumerate all 2304 tuples; each must match exactly one admitted row or the invalid complement, never both/multiple/exception.

transformationV4.evaluation: For an admitted context compute effectiveProviderRequired and baseCauseFamily, then evaluate rows by ascending priority and stop at the first match. Exactly one row must match.
transformationV4.baseCauseFamily: faultCause if base faultCause!=none; else rejectionCause if rejectionCause!=none; else deficiency if deficiency!=none; else none.

rules.notes: base axes already carry signal-after-finalization and must derive the same class/codes as the immutable settled bytes

rules.precedence: Existing exact host fault wins; no provider deficiency may coexist on D9 axes.

providerDeficiencyPatch.causeRule: If base deficiency=none, set providerDeficiency primary and [] secondaries. If base deficiency already non-none and differs, preserve it as primary and append providerDeficiency after existing unique secondaries. A base fault/rejection never reaches this patch.

transformationV4.runtimeFailure: REJECT_CONTEXT before D9; no partial axes/result

hostFinalizerResultV4Schema.authority: All fields are recomputed checked values. Presence is not acceptance and no producer may author them.

hostTerminationUnion.nullabilityPolicy: Optional fields are ABSENT or present-and-valid. No field is ever explicitly null; absence is the only way to express 'not applicable'. This resolves A2-D9-V12-07: a pre-admission failure omits runId entirely rather than carrying null.
hostTerminationUnion.exitCodeInPayload: NOT a union field. exitCode is derived from class via classToExitCode and must not be stored on HostTermination, so the two can never disagree (A2-D9-V12-01).
hostTerminationUnion.forbiddenFieldsRationale: exitCode is derived from class by classToExitCode. Storing it permits the two to disagree — v1.3 declared this and then shipped it in all 38 goldens.

codeMaps.rule: These maps are total and injective. The derivation returns (class, code); a golden whose code disagrees with its axes fails D6.

pinnedD9Projection.checkerCall: After verifying check-d9-v1.13.py through the pinned D9 authority chain, call derive_class(finalAxes) and derive_codes(finalAxes, codeMaps); local reclassification is forbidden.

hostFinalizerBoundaryV4.optionalProviderIdentityRule: For optional+sufficient VERIFIED_UNAVAILABLE or VERIFIED_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, final axes equal exact base axes even when the base already represents policy, deficiency, durability or postcondition outcome. Provider contributes no deficiency.
hostFinalizerBoundaryV4.completeIdentityRule: Every admitted VERIFIED_COMPLETE finalAxes equals exact baseAxes, including signal-after where base axes already carry the settled timing.
hostFinalizerBoundaryV4.faultIdentityRule: Durability failure carries exact durability-commit; required postcondition failure carries exact delivery-required; provider protocol fates carry provider-protocol. No context lacking the applicable faultCause is admitted.

reducerPreservation.rule: Exact semantic projection; checker re-enumerates all 2^11*6 tuples and proves exact one fate before finalizer enumeration.
